purpose: Teach: 用件/彼岸/食中毒/雑用/口元/鳴く/透け/車窓

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、用件、絶対、伝えに、絶対、来たわよ
lines.en: Sho, I came here today to tell you something important. I really mean it.
lines.style: Warm, gentle opening. Soft but deliberate — she's setting something down carefully. Slight pause before the final phrase, as if making sure he's hearing her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくたち、絶対、彼岸、絶対、お墓参り、絶対、行くよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want you to know — I'm going to visit Grandpa's grave during summer break. I really mean it.
lines.style: Quiet, steady. The words come from somewhere thoughtful. Small voice but certain. Not seeking approval, just sharing something he's decided.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、夏のお弁当、絶対、食中毒、絶対、気をつけてね
lines.en: Sho, be careful with your lunch in the summer heat, okay? Food poisoning is no joke.
lines.style: Shifts to practical care. Gentle but firm — the voice of someone looking out for him. Not worried, just attentive. Warm concern without fussing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お家の、絶対、雑用、絶対、お手伝いできるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I can help around the house more. I really can. Just ask me.
lines.style: Eager but not breathless. Wanting to show he's capable, that he's paying attention to what she needs. Small but solid. Offer, not plea.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くんの、本気で、絶対、口元、絶対、いつも、絶対、笑顔、絶対、ね
lines.en: Sho, you know what I notice? Your smile. It's always there, no matter what.
lines.style: Tender observation. Slows down slightly, as if seeing him clearly in this moment. Warm, intimate — the kind of thing you say when you mean to be remembered.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、公園で、絶対、鳥が、絶対、鳴く、絶対、声、絶対、聞こえるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, listen — you can hear the birds singing in the park. Their voices are so clear.
lines.style: Animated, noticing-things energy. Bright and present. He's sharing something he heard, something that struck him. Genuine pleasure in the detail.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、レースのカーテン、絶対、透けて、絶対、お洒落でしょ?翔くん
lines.en: Look at this lace curtain, Sho — the way the light comes through it. Pretty, don't you think?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly playful. Inviting him to see what she sees. Warm but not demanding agreement. The voice of someone sharing a quiet moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんと、本気で、絶対、新幹線の、絶対、車窓、絶対、景色、絶対、見たいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to ride the shinkansen with you and watch the scenery go by. That's what I really want.
lines.style: Quiet yearning. He's imagining something, speaking it aloud like a wish. Soft but sincere. The kind of thing a child says when he trusts you to listen.
